title: PM–Eng cadence reflections — Ryo (pre 1:1)
body:
Context
- Weekly 1:1 with Eng lead (quick sync, escalate blockers, alignment on next sprint). Meeting target: 30 minutes (trim to 20 if schedule tight).
- Primary focus areas for coming sprint: API stability, console rollout, Dedicated capacity pricing experiment, Private on-prem pilot for FinRegCo.

Agenda (compact)
1) Quick wins / kudos (2m) — call out infra team for p95 improvements on hosted-API after batching tweak.
2) API health snapshot (5m) — p95 latency, error budget burn, top 3 regressions.
3) Console rollout plan (7m) — canary metrics, telemetry hooks needed, rollback criteria.
4) Dedicated capacity pricing experiment (7m) — hypothesis, telemetry, experiment length.
5) Private pilot ask + compliance blockers (5m) — what needs SRE/infra for customer onboarding.
6) Decisions / actions (2m)

Status bullets (what I'll bring)
- API: infra pushed v2 KV-cache patch; p99 improved 8% but p95 tail still inconsistent under mixed payloads. Rolling out a targeted flag for 3 customers this week. INF-2381 tracks the rollout.
- Console: UX completed for rollout toggle; missing server-side metrics for route-level latency. Need tracing hook in console service (instrumentation PR linked).
- Dedicated: pricing experiment hypothesis: small reduction in unit price for 3-month commits increases avg commit size. Need a lightweight billing hook and experiment dashboard.
- Private: FinRegCo preflight next Tue — they require HSM key policy + local audit logs. On-prem package almost ready but needs cert rotation docs and an install dry-run with infra.

Open questions to raise
- Are we comfortable shipping the KV-cache flag wide if p95 still noisy? What rollback SLA do we guarantee?
- For console canary: what's the minimum telemetry signal we accept before widening? (error rate + route p95 + customer opt-in)
- Dedicated pricing: do we run A/B at quarter level or pilot with two existing customers? Which gives richer signal with least ops overhead?

Risks / blockers
- Tracing hook depends on infra PR merged (PR #451). If that stalls, console rollout delays 1 sprint.
- Billing hook for pricing experiment requires product-billing time; cherrypick of billing endpoint risky without test harness.
- On-prem dry-run needs a staging cluster with similar network constraints; SRE capacity limited next week.

Proposed decisions I want from 1:1
- Greenlight a limited KV-cache flag rollout to 10% of traffic (two customers + internal) with auto-rollback on 20% increase in error budget.
- Approve console canary telemetry as: route-level p95, error-rate, and trace sampling at 5% (for 2 weeks).
- Run Dedicated pricing pilot with two mid-market customers (shorter timeline, actionable feedback) vs broad A/B.

Action items (who / what / due)
- [Ryo] Draft customer messaging for KV-cache flag rollout + rollback plan — due 2026-03-15.
- [Kai Singh] Push instrumentation PR follow-up and confirm trace sampling config — due 2026-03-14.
- [Leah Morales] Spin up billing sandbox + outline experiment dashboard fields (cost per 1k tokens, commit conversion) — due 2026-03-18.
- [SRE (tentative: Mira)] Provision staging node with network constraints for on-prem dry-run — target dry-run 2026-03-19.
- [Ryo & Eng lead] Decide on Dedicated pilot customers and finalize commit discount parameters — decision meeting 2026-03-16.

Notes to self / spiel for the meeting
- Open with one quick win to keep tone aligned. Keep the console conversation focused on telemetry; avoid getting pulled into UI polish.
- If Eng lead pushes back on Dedicated pilot, propose a smaller sandbox pilot internally to collect ops cost metrics.
- End with concrete due dates and owners; I will follow up in Slack thread after meeting with a 1-line summary + link to this doc.

Follow-up template (post-meeting)
- TL;DR decisions: <two lines>
- Actions assigned: paste action items with owners/dates
- Next sync: confirm next 1:1 date or ad-hoc touchpoint for blockers

Misc references (to paste quickly)
- INF-2381 (rollout ticket)
- Confluence: Console rollouts doc
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-runtime/pull/451

Random scratch ideas (capture, may prune)
- Consider a small "safety-net" route-level cache on console to reduce p95 spikes during deployments.
- Add an experimental metric: cost-per-p95-improvement to quantify trade-offs for Dedicated pricing.

-- end of notes --
